channelProfiles.goal: A trusted, source-first channel for curious adults: Mysteries, Money explained and True stories. Reach YouTube Partner Program eligibility with fewer, better videos.
channelProfiles.target_audience: Curious adults worldwide; English narration, clear and simple pacing, no prior knowledge assumed.
channelProfiles.brand_voice: Calm, steady and factual. Curious but never sensational. Respectful toward real people. Plain English, short sentences.
channelProfiles.call_to_action: If you enjoy careful, source-based stories, subscribe for the next one.
channelProfiles.banned_topics: ["guaranteed return","guaranteed profit","get rich quick","risk-free investment","buy this stock","stock pick","coin pick","price target","you should invest in","miracle cure","cures cancer","graphic gore"]
channelProfiles.visual_style: Real stock footage, maps, licensed or public-domain archival images, and clearly stylized illustrations. No realistic recreations of real people. Readable, high-contrast on-screen text.

channelStrategies.objective: Build a trusted, source-first channel for curious adults with three recurring series: Mysteries, Money explained and True stories. Launch publicly in January 2027 with a backlog of 10-15 approved videos, then reach YouTube Partner Program eligibility (1,000 subscribers plus 8,000 qualified public watch hours in 365 days) through fewer, better, clearly sourced long-form videos. Never mass-produced, never misleading.
channelStrategies.audience: Curious adults worldwide who enjoy unexplained mysteries, space and history, money concepts explained simply, and documented real-life survival stories. English narration, clear and simple pacing, no prior knowledge assumed.
channelStrategies.value_proposition: Every video separates what is known, what experts believe and what is speculation, with a named source for every claim, so viewers can trust what they learn.
channelStrategies.content_pillars: ["Mysteries: unexplained events, space and the universe, history's open questions","Money explained: how money concepts work (education only, never advice)","True stories: documented real incidents and survival stories, told respectfully"]
channelStrategies.success_metric: Qualified public watch hours toward YPP: 8,000 in 365 days plus 1,000 subscribers. Organic only: no self-views, bots or engagement manipulation.
channelStrategies.constraints:
CHANNEL BIBLE (mandatory for every agent)
1. Sources: every factual claim needs a named source. A script with unsupported central claims is blocked.
2. Certainty labels: separate 'what is known', 'what experts believe' and 'speculation', and say which is which.
3. People: no realistic AI recreations of real people, especially victims or children. No real victims' faces or voices. No realistic AI-generated children. No graphic gore. Calm, factual, respectful tone.
4. Money explained is education only: no financial advice, no stock, crypto or coin picks, no price predictions, no get-rich promises. No medical claims in any series.
5. Packaging: titles and thumbnails create curiosity but must match the video. No misleading promises or clickbait the video does not deliver.
6. AI disclosure: set the altered or synthetic media flag whenever content looks realistic, and always state AI-assisted narration in the description.
7. Originality: every video needs its own angle. Vary structure, hooks, pacing and visuals so the channel never looks templated or mass-produced. Fewer, better videos.
8. Credits: credit stock-footage photographers and videographers in the description.
9. Cadence and approval: at most 2 long-form videos per week. Nothing publishes without human approval; uploads stay private until approved.
10. Growth: never use self-views, bots or engagement manipulation.
